notes: The Wins tab has 65 milestones now, up from 9 — and they are sized to your debt, not to round dollar amounts. Someone paying off $6,000 and someone paying off $60,000 reach them at the same rate.
Up Next sits at the top and shows the three closest, with exactly how far away each one is.
Some arrive without a payment at all — a run of months in a row, your biggest month of the last twelve, interest your plan avoids, and every month you pull your debt-free date earlier.
A missed month never breaks a run on its own. Life happens, and one is quietly forgiven.
Milestones you had already reached are marked as earned when you update, with no pile of pop-ups for things that happened months ago. All of it is free.
